programme.title: Love, Again [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Jae-yeon's leg hasn't grown since she was twelve. She is a bioscientist researching on artificial blood based on a chloroplast. She believes that the chloroplast will help the recovery of one's physical body. At the conference, her assertion is considered as purely theoretical, while Soo-hee, her co-worker who stole her idea, gets good reviews. Moreover, Prof. Jung, Jae-yeon's lover, is having an affair with Soo-hee. That's why she isolated herself in the woods where she grew up. Meanwhile, Ji-hoon is an unknown novelist who has a hard time. His girlfriend broke up with him, and his career is in danger after his disrespectful behavior at a social gathering. He finds writing on the wall, saying, ''I was born from a tree.'' He asks around about the previous tenant and finds Jae-yeon in the woods. He starts observing her life and write what he sees as a novel.

programme.title: Pins and Nettie
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Peztronauta
programme.desc: BarryTiger es una serie animada en 3D vibrante y cautivadora, diseñada para niños de 1 a 8 años, que da vida a aventuras cotidianas a través de música pegajosa y encantadora. Con una variedad de personajes coloridos y temas ricos y diversos, la serie muestra los momentos alegres de la vida de la familia BarryTiger. La producción musical de alta calidad, con melodías excepcionales, arreglos sobresalientes y actuaciones destacadas, añade una capa extra de diversión a las escenas animadas y dinámicas. ¡Prepárate para cantar, bailar y explorar junto a Barry y sus amigos en cada emocionante episodio!

Con una variedad de personajes coloridos y temas ricos y diversos, la serie muestra los momentos alegres de la vida de la familia BarryTiger. La producción musical de alta calidad, con melodías excepcionales, arreglos sobresalientes y actuaciones destacadas, añade una capa extra de diversión a las escenas animadas y dinámicas. ¡Prepárate para cantar, bailar y explorar junto a Barry y sus amigos en cada emocionante episodio!

programme.title: Love, Again [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Jae-yeon's leg hasn't grown since she was twelve. She is a bioscientist researching on artificial blood based on a chloroplast. She believes that the chloroplast will help the recovery of one's physical body. At the conference, her assertion is considered as purely theoretical, while Soo-hee, her co-worker who stole her idea, gets good reviews. Moreover, Prof. Jung, Jae-yeon's lover, is having an affair with Soo-hee. That's why she isolated herself in the woods where she grew up. Meanwhile, Ji-hoon is an unknown novelist who has a hard time. His girlfriend broke up with him, and his career is in danger after his disrespectful behavior at a social gathering. He finds writing on the wall, saying, ''I was born from a tree.'' He asks around about the previous tenant and finds Jae-yeon in the woods. He starts observing her life and write what he sees as a novel.

programme.title: The National Report
programme.desc: Host Philippe Cousteau travels to Curacao and dives along the coral reefs to capture lionfish, an invasive species that's destroying the sea life in these waters. We visit the Chesapeake Bay to see what's being done to restore the oyster population. Then Philippe goes to Alaska and sees some areas that are still suffering from the Exxon-Valdez oil spill, which occurred over 25 years ago. Then we explore how the Mississippi River can be used to rebuild the disappearing wetlands in Louisiana.

We visit the Chesapeake Bay to see what's being done to restore the oyster population. Then Philippe goes to Alaska and sees some areas that are still suffering from the Exxon-Valdez oil spill, which occurred over 25 years ago. Then we explore how the Mississippi River can be used to rebuild the disappearing wetlands in Louisiana.

Then Philippe goes to Alaska and sees some areas that are still suffering from the Exxon-Valdez oil spill, which occurred over 25 years ago. Then we explore how the Mississippi River can be used to rebuild the disappearing wetlands in Louisiana.
